title: Uniform Residential Appraisal Report
description: A residential real estate appraisal on the redesigned Uniform Residential Appraisal Report (URAR), as used by lenders, AMCs and underwriters to support a mortgage decision.

report.description: Identifiers printed in the report header and footer.

amc_reference_id.description: AMC Reference ID, or null if none.

summary.description: The Summary section on the first page of the report.

opinion_of_market_value.description: Opinion of Market Value in dollars, as a number.

market_value_condition.description: Market Value Condition, e.g. As Is or Subject to Repair.

effective_date.description: Effective Date of Appraisal, as printed (MM/DD/YYYY).

assignment_reason.description: Assignment Reason, e.g. Purchase or Refinance.

contract_price.description: Contract Price in dollars, or null if there is no contract.

property_valuation_method.description: Property Valuation Method, e.g. Traditional Appraisal.

overall_condition.description: Overall Condition rating (C1-C6) on which the market value is based.

as_is_overall_condition.description: As Is Overall Condition Rating (C1-C6), if reported separately.

parties.description: Parties named in Assignment Information and Contact Information.

appraiser_license_level.description: Appraiser credential level, e.g. Certified Residential.

street_address.description: Street line of the subject's physical address.

property_rights_appraised.description: Property Rights Appraised, e.g. Fee Simple.

site_size_sq_ft.description: Total Site Size in square feet.

finished_area_above_grade_sq_ft.description: Finished area above grade in square feet.

finished_area_below_grade_sq_ft.description: Finished area below grade in square feet.

hoa_monthly_fee.description: Mandatory Fees (HOA, PUD or Co-op) monthly amount in dollars.

comparables.description: The comparable sales in the Sales Comparison Approach grid, in order Comparable #1, #2, #3 and so on. Do not include the Subject Property column or the Additional Properties Analyzed Not Used.

comparable_number.description: The comparable's number in the grid (1, 2, 3...).

proximity_to_subject.description: Proximity to Subject, as printed, e.g. 0.17 Miles N.

sale_price.description: Sale Price in dollars, from the Summary rows of the grid.

net_adjustment_total.description: Net Adjustment Total in dollars from the Summary rows; negative if shown in parentheses.

adjusted_price.description: Adjusted Price in dollars from the Summary rows.

comparable_weight.description: Comparable Weight from the Summary rows, e.g. Most or Less.

indicated_value_sales_comparison.description: Indicated Value by Sales Comparison Approach, in dollars.

defects.description: Each row of the Apparent Defects, Damages, Deficiencies table in the Reconciliation section (the full list).

affects_soundness.description: Affects Soundness or Structural Integrity: true for Yes.

recommended_action.description: Recommended Action, e.g. Repair or None.

estimated_cost_to_repair.description: Estimated Cost to Repair in dollars, or null if blank.
